acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a plumbing company for a repipe in the Las Vegas area, look for licensed and insured professionals with specific experience in whole-home repiping. Check for local reviews and testimonials, and ensure they offer clear communication and transparent estimates. A company that provides a detailed assessment and explains material options (PEX vs. copper) is often a good indicator of thoroughness. CG Plumbing Solutions specializes in repiping services and provides comprehensive, tailored solutions to homeowners in the Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, Henderson, and Summerlin areas.
